name: Google Docs
note: Current web editor, PC/ChromeOS and Mac columns. Where the vendor lists multiple alternate chords for one action, only the primary chord is recorded. Multi-step 'hold Ctrl+Alt(+Shift), then key1 then key2' shortcuts are modeled as a two-chord sequence with the modifiers repeated on both chords. Mouse-only shortcuts (double/triple-click selection, right-click) and the browser context-menu shortcut are omitted.
